# CalorAI

> CalorAI is an AI calorie counter app for Android and iPhone. Take a photo of a meal (or type or say what you ate) and it estimates calories, protein, carbs and fat in seconds. Free to download; some advanced features are part of CalorAI Pro. Available in 18 languages, including Arabic.

CalorAI is made by Intellivation AB (Sweden). Package name on Google Play: com.caloraiapp.app. App Store ID: 6742805996.

## Key facts
- Platforms: Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store, iPhone and iPad)
- Price: free download; optional CalorAI Pro subscription for advanced features
- Languages (18): English, Arabic, Danish, German, Greek, Spanish, Farsi, Finnish, French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Kurdish, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Turkish. Arabic, Farsi and Kurdish use a right-to-left layout.
- Food recognition covers many cuisines, including Middle Eastern and Gulf dishes.
- Logging methods: photo of the meal, gallery photo, typed description, or voice description. CalorAI does not scan video.

## Features
- Photo calorie counting: calories, protein, carbs and fat per meal, with an editable portion size
- Daily calorie and macro targets based on height, weight, age, activity and goal
- Weight goal plan: target weight, daily calories, a weekly pace and milestones
- Workout logging: 100+ exercises with duration and intensity; burned calories are added to the daily target
- AI nutrition coach (chat by text or voice)
- AI meal planner
- Health warnings for ingredients that may not suit 20+ conditions (for example gluten, dairy, acid reflux); not medical advice
- Vitamins and minerals overview, monthly calendar and progress tracking

## Accuracy
Photo results are AI estimates, like a nutrition label. Users can adjust any meal before saving it.
